_comment: V6 configuration — Multi-Layer Feedback Transformer on ViZDoom deathmatch (the arena). Encoder: per-layer CROSS-attention (Q = patch tokens; K/V = [X ++ ALL layer memories ++ game-state tokens]) + per-layer per-token LSTM (hierarchical update order, v5 lineage). Decoders: CLS transformers over [H1..HL]; critic is single-pass distributional QR-DQN (A x n_quantiles from the CLS). Trainer: PAC actor loss (MPO E-step + BC) + quantile-Huber critic + prioritized SEGMENT replay (R2D2 stored-state, burn-in) + EMA target network. Priority for any setting: CLI arg > this config > script default.

run._note_init_mode: fresh = random init; warm_start = partial load (skip mismatches); resume = strict load.
run._note_checkpoint_location: checkpoint_dir points OUTSIDE the repo on purpose: AttentionManuscript is a Google Drive sync root and Drive was observed rewriting checkpoints mid-session (corrupted a run). Keep live checkpoints in a non-synced home dir.

environment._comment: deathmatch.cfg — the arena. Reward REVISED after the run-1 postmortem (2026-06-10): KILLCOUNT is the GLOBAL map kill tally (a noop policy earns ~1 kill/ep from monster infighting — verified over 60 episodes), so the old +1*dKILLCOUNT term was non-contingent free credit and the policy collapsed into wall-shooting. Now: kill bonus GATED on same-step player damage/hits; player-attributed DAMAGECOUNT/HITCOUNT carry the signal; firing costs ammo so wall-spray is strictly negative; medkit pickups pay. KILLCOUNT remains the headline METRIC.

model._note_patch: obs is (3,60,80) (RES_160X120 avg-pooled 2x). patch_size=10 -> 6x8 grid = 48 tokens, each covering 20x20 native pixels.
model._note_enc: enc_layers = feedback layers = recurrent memory states. Each layer cross-attends Q=patch over [X ++ H1..HL ++ 3 state tokens] = N*(1+L)+3 keys. 8 heads (16-d) — the v5_part2 choice.

rl._note_actions: 14 button combos — see env.ACTION_NAMES. init_action_bias zeros: warmup collects with a uniform-random policy anyway.

trainer._comment: PAC (MPO+BC) + QR-DQN + segment PER + EMA target.
trainer._note_entropy: Run-1 postmortem: 0.01 was 10-100x too weak to oppose the E-step feedback runaway (entropy collapsed 2.64->0.3 and the policy froze on 3/14 actions). 0.1 is within the verified-needed range.
trainer._note_n_step: n-step distributional TD target (n=1 recovers v5's exact 1-step form). 3 is the standard sparse-reward choice (R2D2 uses 5).
trainer._note_mpo: Run-1 postmortem: the E-step reference pi_theta' is the EMA of the SAME policy being trained -> positive-feedback runaway. Simulated: eta=0.1 collapses entropy 2.64->0.003 on a 0.05 Q-edge (even with bc_alpha=0); eta=1.0 stable. ref_uniform_mix mixes the reference with uniform so it can never zero-out an action (breaks the loop at the source); bc_alpha halved (self-imitation amplifier); explore_eps = uniform-random floor during collection so the replay distribution never collapses.
trainer._note_ema: EMA/Polyak target after EVERY optimizer step: theta' <- (1-tau)theta' + tau*theta. tau=0.01 -> ~100-step time constant, the same lag scale as v5's hard copy every 100 steps. Provides BOTH the TD bootstrap and the MPO E-step reference policy.
trainer._note_warmup: First N iters: uniform-random actions, critic-only training (actor frozen) — fills the PER buffer and settles the value scale before the policy moves.
trainer._note_burn_in: Per-segment loss-masked prefix: re-encoded from the stored (slightly stale) recurrent state, these steps warm the state but contribute to no loss and no priority (R2D2 burn-in).
